hero_eyebrow: Get The Best Tan Of Your Life In Tel Aviv   שיזוף בהתזה בתל אביב
hero_sub: Get a customised hand-applied airbrush spraytan that I mix specifically to your undertone, results never fake looking. Fades beautifully. Worn by brides, models, and anyone who refuses to look orange
philo_heading: We don't spray tans. We *compose* them.
philo_p1: Everyone's skin has its own natural shade— an undertone of olive, rose, or gold that decides how color will develop on it. After two decades of customising tans daily, I can predict your perfect spraytan shade before applying a single drop of solution. The result is a shade that suits only you and your desired tan. No two spray tans are the same.
philo_p2: My solutions are imported, FDA approved, and blended by hand in my studio. I also carry PETA safe products, free of scents, parabens free, and the option to contour.  My spraytan technique is refined after tanning thousands of brides, editorial shoots, and celebrities— whether you'd like to look like you spent the summer in Ibiza or just don't want to look like you're white as a ghost with just a hint of color, I've got you covered!

protocol_intro: A few quiet rituals before and after your session decide how evenly your shade develops — and how gracefully it leaves.
pro1_body: Complete any waxing or shaving now, so pores can settle. If you can, exfoliate gently the day before — polished skin takes retains color better. Then leave your skin alone: no oils, no self-tanner remnants, nothing on your skin.
pro2_body: Arrive with bare skin — no moisturizer, deodorant, perfume, or makeup. Bring loose, dark clothing and flip flops. The solution needs room to breathe; so do you.
pro3_body: This is when your shade develops. No water, no sweat, no tight straps. When the time is up, rinse in lukewarm water without soap and pat, never rub, yourself dry. The outcome will be the best tan you dreamed of ❤️
pro4_body: Keep showers short and lukewarm, and give pools and long sea swims a few days' grace. Cared for this way, your glow fades slowly, evenly, and entirely on its own terms.
